info.name: 📌 DeepInfra API
info.description:
### About Deep Infra

"DeepInfra offers cost-effective, scalable, easy-to-deploy, and production-ready machine-learning models and infrastructures for deep-learning models."

DeepInfra runs a large catalog of open models from other labs, such as DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama and Nemotron, through OpenAI-compatible Chat and Responses APIs. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Inference hosts**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- DeepInfra Account: [https://deepinfra.com/](https://deepinfra.com/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `deepinfra_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:deepinfra_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://deepinfra.com/docs](https://deepinfra.com/docs)
    
- Models: [https://deepinfra.com/models](https://deepinfra.com/models)
